route.prompt: Which team should pick up this customer or seller message?

criteria.delivery: Where an order is, late or missing deliveries, delivery slots, wrong address, items damaged in transit.
criteria.returns: Returning items, refunds for returned, spoiled or unwanted items, substitutions the customer did not want.
criteria.payments: Card declined, double charges, promo codes not applied, gift card balances, payment methods.
criteria.login: Cannot sign in, password resets, verification codes, locked accounts, changing the account email or phone.
criteria.product_info: Questions about a product: ingredients, allergens, sizes, availability, shelf life, recalls.
criteria.seller_support: Sellers on the marketplace: listings, payouts to sellers, seller fees, shop suspensions, inventory sync.
criteria.fraud: Unauthorised orders or charges, account takeover, scam messages impersonating Fernhill, stolen gift cards.

urgency.prompt: Rate the urgency of this message. low: a general question or request with no deadline. normal: a problem that needs fixing but does not stop the customer or seller today. high: stops a customer or seller from completing something today, or puts money or health at risk within a day or two. critical: many customers or sellers affected at once, an account takeover or fraud in progress, or a food-safety danger.
